probes.probe_rule: first cell, last cell with left < 1/4, last cell meeting (0,2]; fixed before any R''' value exists

object: certified enclosure [L, U] of R'''_{D,m}(e) over the whole probe cell: midpoint order-3 rung (F_r:k3 r=0..4, S_r:3, W:3, h_j:3) plus whole-cell 4th-order remainder rho*T[R,4] (Aux3 governance pattern Q3-Q7); outward exact rational endpoints

Q1_ENCLOSABLE.PASS: for all 24 (probe, m): finite certified [L, U] produced (tower self-consistency q_N < 1, no NaN/inf)
Q1_ENCLOSABLE.FAIL: any probe cell yields no finite enclosure -> FAIL_ENCLOSURE for that detector

Q2_NEAR_ZERO_SIGN.PASS: cell 0 of the detector: L > 0 for every m
Q2_NEAR_ZERO_SIGN.STOP: SR cell 0: L <= 0 for any m -> STOP the SR R''' route (no expansion); CUSUM cell 0 likewise stops the CUSUM route
Q2_NEAR_ZERO_SIGN.COUNTEREXAMPLE_SIGNAL: U < 0 at cell 0 for some m -> recorded for independent adjudication (certified R''' < 0 near 0 contradicts H3a); the oracle issues no verdict

Q3_NARROW_FOR_BRIDGE.PASS: cell 0: sign-determinate (L > 0), the only width the bridge needs at the first cell
Q3_NARROW_FOR_BRIDGE.REPORT_ONLY: cells 207/294 (SR), 221/309 (CUSUM): L, U, U-L and sign-determinacy per m; no pass/fail (the bridge falls back to K1 H_k/Gamma_k there; sufficiency is result-dependent)

Q4_COST.REPORT_ONLY: CPU-s, wall-s, peak RSS per probe cell; stratum projection to the 605 cells = sum over strata [0,1/4), [1/4,2) of (probe cost x cell count); no cap is set by the oracle

halt_rules: no expansion beyond the 6 probe cells under any outcome
no refinement, splitting or precision change after results
a STOP outcome ends the route; a new route requires a new predeclared successor
execution_precondition: a governed certified order-3 producer (identity-bound) exists for the detector. SR: NONE exists (p5y_k1_sr_o9_aux3_successor stopped at Phase-4 float feasibility, AUX3_SR_FEASIBILITY_FAIL). CUSUM: Aux4 computes order-3 SOURCE objects only (no F_r:k3).
